description.en: Intended to check whether a party member's TP (Technique Points) gauge is maxed out, by handle — the TP counterpart to CMND_GP_IS_MAX, with the same caveat about its return value not visibly reflecting the internal check in the decompiled code.

True once the handle resolves to a party member (the internal TP-max comparison doesn't visibly affect the returned value in the decompiled code); null if the call was invalid or the handle doesn't resolve to a party member.
